vectors.name: stealth_meta_address_attested
vectors.note: On a stealth route the payout does NOT go to recipient -- recipient is the connected wallet there, and the funds land at a counterfactual account derived at settlement from a fresh ephemeral key. The meta-address is the only quote-time-stable identifier of the destination, so it is what gets signed. Compressed pubkeys are 0x-prefixed and therefore lowercased like any other 0x value.

vectors.name: refund_address_base58_verbatim
vectors.note: The v3 field. refund_address is where a FAILED deposit is returned, and it is precedence 1 in DepositRefund.refund_dest_address/2 -- ahead of wallet and ahead of the on-chain sender. Unsigned in v2, it let an attacker replay a victim's request with their own refund address and collect on any failed fill. On a Tron origin it is base58, so it is verbatim like every other base58 value.

vectors.name: refund_address_evm_lowercased
vectors.note: An EVM-origin deposit route: refund_address is 0x-prefixed and therefore lowercased, on the same rule as every other 0x value. Pairs with the base58 case above so a client cannot pass both by folding everything or by folding nothing.
